forum.title: STM32CubeMx 6.18.0 missing X-CUBE-AZRTOS-H5
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Gehs

ThreadX and FileX already appear in the Middleware section of STM32CubeMX for your STM32H5 MCU ,this means Azure RTOS support is already integrated and you do not need to install X-CUBE-AZRTOS-H5 separately.

In case of need , use this link to install it :[X-CUBE-AZURE-H5 | Product - STMicroelectronics](https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/x-cube-azure-h5.html)

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/9598ef08-b350-4df8-b731-2bcce11ebd0c.png)

THX

Ghofrane
